NONE: › a brand name for a large, iron cooker that keeps its heat
雅家爐（一種可用以烹飪或取暖的保溫爐灶）
› a story about the lives of people who have a good standard of living and live in the English countryside
雅家小說（反映英國鄉村中家境較好者的生活）
A1 one more time
又，再一次
A2 back to the original place or condition
（回）到原處；復原
B1 If something happens once again, it has already happened several times before.
（數次發生後）再次；再三
› said after an unpleasant experience to show that you do not intend to do it again
（表示不願再經歷不愉快的事情）受夠了！再也不做了！
B2 If something happens yet again, it has already happened many times before.
（多次發生後）再次；屢次
B1 repeatedly
一再，屢次
B2 If you do something all over again, you start again from the beginning.
重新做起，從頭再來
› in addition to the amount we know about or have mentioned already
增加；多

example: Could you spell your name again, please?
請您再拼一次您的名字好嗎？
If he does it again I'll have to tell him.
如果他再這麼做，我就不能不提醒他了。
Deborah's late again.
黛博拉又遲到了。
Throw it away and start again.
扔了它，重新開始。
We went to Edinburgh and back again all in one day.
我們去了愛丁堡，當天又回來了。
Get some rest and you'll soon be well again.
休息一下，你很快就會康復的。
You are reminded once again of the author's love of the sea.
你會再次感受到作者對大海的熱愛。
He drove me back home last night. Never again!
昨晚他開車把我送回家。以後再也不讓他送了！
I'm afraid it's been delayed yet again.
恐怕這又給耽誤了。
I've told you again and again not to do that.
我一再告訴過你不要那樣做。
It's already taken me two hours - I don't want to have to do it all over again.
這已經花了我兩個鐘頭了，我可不想從頭再做一次。
They are paid half as much again as we are.
他們的薪水比我們的多一半。

NONE: A2 disagreeing with a plan or activity
反對；與…相反
C1 If you have something against someone, you dislike them for a reason.
因（某種原因）不喜歡（某人）
› If something counts/goes/works against you, it gives you a disadvantage.
對…不利
A2 next to and touching or being supported by (something)
緊貼著；緊靠著；倚在
› in front of or compared to
以…為背景；以…作襯托；和…對照
B1 in the opposite direction to
逆…的方向；迎著
› as a protection or defence from the bad effects of
防…；抗…

example: She spoke against the decision to close the college.
她聲言反對關閉學院的決定。
50 people voted against the new proposal.
50人投票反對這項新提案。
I'm very much against the idea that it is the woman's job to bring up the child.
對於撫養孩子是女人的職責這個想法，我堅決反對。
Germany are playing against Brazil in the cup final tonight.
德國隊在今晚的決賽中對陣巴西隊。
She's always rebelled against authority.
她總是對抗權威。
She sold the house even though it was against his wishes.
她賣掉了房子，儘管這違背了他的意願。
They called a demonstration to protest against proposed job cuts.
他們召集了示威遊行來抗議削減工作機會的提議。
Are you for or against my proposal?
你贊成還是反對我的提議？
Sanctions against the country should be lifted.
應該取消對這個國家的制裁。
Stricter controls will help in the fight against inflation.
更加嚴厲的調控措施將有助於抑制通貨膨脹。
Criminal charges will be brought against the driver.
將對司機提出刑事訴訟。
They decided not to take legal action against him.
他們決定不起訴他。
They were up against a powerful pressure group.
他們面臨一個強大的壓力集團。
We came up against a lot of problems in the course of building our extension.
我們在擴建過程中遇到好多問題。
The chances/odds against you winning such a competition are enormous.
你贏得這樣一場比賽的可能性極小。
It's against the law (= illegal) to leave children under a certain age alone in the house.
將某個年齡以下的孩子單獨留在家裡是違法的。
It's against my beliefs/principles to be nice to someone I dislike just because they're in a senior position.
對於我厭惡的人，我不會僅僅因為他的職位比我高就對其和顏悅色，這有違我的處世原則。
Against all probability (= although it was extremely unlikely) we found ourselves in the same hotel.
不可思議的是，我們發現自己竟然住進了同一家旅館。
I wouldn't dare say anything against him (= criticize him) to his mother!
我不敢對他媽媽說他的壞話！
I've nothing against him - I just don't have much in common with him.
我一點都不討厭他，只是和他沒有太多相似之處。
Lack of experience will generally count against you in an interview.
一般而言，缺乏工作經驗會成為面試的不利因素。
Why don't we put the bed against the wall?
為甚麼不把床緊靠牆放呢？
He loved the feel of her soft hair against his skin.
他喜歡她那柔順的秀髮貼著他的肌膚的感覺。
The rain beat against her face as she struggled through the wind.
她在風雨中艱難前進，雨水打在她的臉上。
The police officer had him up against the wall, both arms behind his back.
員警把他雙手別在身後按到牆上。
She leaned against the door.
她倚著門。
Paintings look best against a simple white wall.
畫掛在沒有任何裝飾的白牆上看上去效果最好。
The last part of the course was hard because I was running against the wind.
最後一段賽程很艱難，因為我是逆風跑。
Commuting is not so bad when you are travelling against the traffic.
如果你是逆著主車流而行，乘車上下班倒也不錯。
We've insured the car against fire, theft, and accident.
我們替車買了火險、盜竊保險和交通意外保險。
The police have to arm themselves against attack.
警方必須配備武器以防受到襲擊。

NONE: C2 If you do or achieve something against (all) the odds/against all odds, you do or achieve it although there were a lot of problems and you were not likely to succeed.
儘管困難重重；在極為不利的情況下

example: Against all the odds, he recovered.
他克服一切不利病況康復了。

NONE: › If you do something against the clock, you do it as fast as possible and try to finish it before a certain time.
搶時間，爭分奪秒
› When people do something against the clock, the time they take to do it is recorded, in order to find which person or attempt is the fastest.
計時（決名次）
› If you do something against time/the clock, you do it as fast as possible and try to finish it before a certain time.
（為了如期完成而）爭分奪秒，加快工作，搶時間

example: It was a real race against time to get all the costumes sewn for the play.
趕製演出的戲服真是如同與時間賽跑一樣。

NONE: › If something is against your better judgment, you think it would be wiser not to do it.
違心；明知不可取

example: Against my better judgment, I gave him the job.
我違心地給了他這份工作。
